text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to rescind one accessible parking space on each side of Lindsey Avenue, and to implement an accessible loading zone on the north side, in effect at all times. This change would add one permit parking space on the south side of Lindsey Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the accessible parking space, operating from December 1 of one year to March 31 of the next following year, and from the 1st day to the 15th day of each month, from April 1 to November 30, inclusive, on the south side of Lindsey Avenue, from a point 13.5 metres east of Gladstone Avenue to a point 5.5 metres further east. 2. Rescinded the accessible parking space, operating from the 16th day to the last day of each month, from April 1 to November 30, inclusive, on the north side of Lindsey Avenue, from a point 20.5 metres east of Gladstone Avenue to a point 5.5 metres further east. 3. Approved the installation of an accessible loading zone, operating at all times, on the north side of Lindsey Avenue, from a point 20.5 metres east of Gladstone Avenue to a point 5.5 metres further east.
